metadata.question: Between 2003 and 2019, did Africa's total land area covered by crops increase by more than 400,000 square kilometers?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MCD12Q1 v6.1 annual land cover (MODIS/061/MCD12Q1) at 500 m for years 2003 and 2019 over Africa (USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017 filtered by wld_rgn='Africa'). Fallback to v6 (MODIS/006/MCD12Q1) if needed.
2. Masking strategy: Not a cloud problem. Mask cropland classes in IGBP scheme: 12 (Croplands) and 14 (Cropland/Natural Mosaic).
3. Logic: Check collection size per year; if 0 after fallback => C1. Compute masked pixel count; if 0 => C2. Compute area; if null/NaN/invalid => C3. Compare 2019-2003 area to 400,000 km² to answer A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const africaFc = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017').filter(ee.Filter.eq('wld_rgn', 'Africa'));
    const africa = africaFc.geometry();

    const dsPrimary = 'MODIS/061/MCD12Q1';
    const dsFallback = 'MODIS/006/MCD12Q1';

    async function getYearImage(year) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'year');
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(dsPrimary).filterDate(start, end);
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        col = ee.ImageCollection(dsFallback).filterDate(start, end);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size === 0) {
          return {img: null, size: 0, dataset: null};
        }
        return {img: col.first(), size: size, dataset: dsFallback};
      }
      return {img: col.first(), size: size, dataset: dsPrimary};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const y1 = 2003;
    const y2 = 2019;

    const res2003 = await getYearImage(y1);
    const res2019 = await getYearImage(y2);

    console.log(`2003 Images: ${res2003.size}${res2003.dataset ? ' (' + res2003.dataset + ')' : ''}`);
    console.log(`2019 Images: ${res2019.size}${res2019.dataset ? ' (' + res2019.dataset + ')' : ''}`);

    if (res2003.size === 0 || res2019.size === 0) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    function cropMask(img) {
      // Use IGBP class labels on LC_Type1: 12=Croplands, 14=Cropland/Natural Mosaic
      const lc = img.select('LC_Type1');
      return lc.eq(12).or(lc.eq(14));
    }

    async function computeCropStats(img, region) {
      const lc = img.select('LC_Type1');
      const mask = cropMask(img);
      const lcMasked = lc.updateMask(mask);
      const count = await lcMasked.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo();

      const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(mask);
      const areaM2 = await areaImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('area').getInfo();

      return {count: count || 0, areaKm2: (areaM2 != null) ? (areaM2 / 1e6) : null};
    }

    // 3. Processing and Validation
    const stats2003 = await computeCropStats(res2003.img, africa);
    const stats2019 = await computeCropStats(res2019.img, africa);

    if (stats2003.count === 0 || stats2019.count === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (stats2003.areaKm2 == null || stats2019.areaKm2 == null ||
        !isFinite(stats2003.areaKm2) || !isFinite(stats2019.areaKm2) ||
        stats2003.areaKm2 < 0 || stats2019.areaKm2 < 0) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const delta = stats2019.areaKm2 - stats2003.areaKm2;

    // 5. Evidence and Final Answer
    console.log(`2003 Crop px: ${stats2003.count}, Area_km2: ${stats2003.areaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`2019 Crop px: ${stats2019.count}, Area_km2: ${stats2019.areaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`Δ Area_km2 (2019-2003): ${delta.toFixed(0)}`);

    // Final decision: more than 400,000 km² increase?
    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (delta > 400000) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
